title: fly and 100 functions
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Eski GUI bo'lsa o'chirib tashlash
local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SleepFloodGui")
if oldGui then
	oldGui:Destroy()
end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "SleepFloodGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

-- Orqa fon
local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
bg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
bg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 25)
bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
bg.Parent = screenGui

-- 99 tilda "sleep/uxla" so'zlari
local sleepWords = {
	"Uxla", "Sleep", "Dormir", "Schlafen", "Спать", "Uyumak", "眠る", "잠", "睡觉", "Dormi",
	"Sova", "Sove", "Slaap", "Sov", "Sovejte", "Spavaj", "Spí", "Spi", "Lala", "Doze",
	"Nap", "Rest", "Repose", "Descansar", "Reposar", "Спи", "Yat", "Ngủ", "Tidur", "Tulog",
	"Matulog", "Kumalala", "Nidra", "So", "Moe", "Sueno", "Droom", "Schlof", "Shlafen", "Sove",
	"Nuku", "Sove", "Spink", "Somni", "Dorme", "Duerme", "Duerma", "Spava", "Leep", "Sussa",
	"Somn", "Usa", "Unta", "Ninni", "Hypnos", "Sueña", "Qis", "Oram", "Yuxu", "Puhka", "Viska",
	"Nuku hästi", "Sov godt", "Nocuj", "Śpij", "Spink lekker", "Nid", "Nidra karo", "Zzz", "🛏️",
	"🛌", "Sleep Now", "Go Sleep", "Good Night", "Sweet Dreams", "Uyqu", "Yot", "Dam ol", "Tin ol",
	"Rest now", "Nap time", "Bed time", "Dream", "Close eyes", "Silent sleep", "Night rest", "Moon sleep",
	"Deep sleep", "Soft sleep", "Calm sleep", "Sleep tight", "Uyla emas Uxla", "SLEEP", "UXLA", "🛏️ Uxla", "🛌 Sleep"
}

-- Kichik yozuvlarni ekranga sochib chiqish
for i = 1, 140 do
	local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	txt.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.random(80, 180), 0, math.random(25, 50))
	txt.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(), -50, math.random(), -20)
	txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	txt.Text = sleepWords[math.random(1, #sleepWords)]
	txt.TextScaled = true
	txt.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	txt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
		math.random(180,255),
		math.random(180,255),
		math.random(180,255)
	)
	txt.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	txt.Rotation = math.random(-25, 25)
	txt.Parent = bg
end

-- Markazdagi asosiy yozuv
local mainText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
mainText.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.22, 0)
mainText.Position = UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0.39, 0)
mainText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
mainText.Text = "🛏️  UXLA / SLEEP  🛌"
mainText.TextScaled = true
mainText.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
mainText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
mainText.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 255)
mainText.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
mainText.Parent = bg

-- Pastki yozuv
local subText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
subText.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.08, 0)
subText.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.75, 0)
subText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
subText.Text = "sleep sleep sleep • uxla uxla uxla • 🛏️🛌"
subText.TextScaled = true
subText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
subText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 255)
subText.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
subText.Parent = bg

-- Yengil miltillash effekti
task.spawn(function()
	while screenGui.Parent do
		mainText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(150,255), math.random(150,255), math.random(255))
		task.wait(0.35)
	end
end)
